dependency.purpose: Connect shared-service symptoms to the business functions waiting on them.
questions: Which functions share the abnormal dependency?
Which teams can start with a narrower investigation?
dependency.needed: Request traces, independent application telemetry and change history are needed to establish an initiating cause.
dependency.decision: Coordinate the shared-service owner and affected function owners; validate the continuity path.

facility.purpose: Investigate how physical conditions intersect with digital service continuity.
questions: Which services depend on the affected physical component?
Which site and service owners need to coordinate?
facility.needed: Sensor thresholds, redundant capacity and site procedures are needed before a transfer or environmental diagnosis.
facility.decision: Compare the physical observation with the digital dependency path and verify alternate capacity.

containment.purpose: Compare a security signal with the operational consequences of containment.
questions: Which business functions could be interrupted by isolation?
Which access or boundary evidence needs validation?
containment.needed: Identity, network and threat evidence are needed to validate a security incident. A status alert alone does not establish compromise.
containment.decision: Review containment scope, continuity and the security approval gate before acting.

change.purpose: Bring dependency impact and current evidence into a change decision.
questions: What is affected and what evidence blocks a decision?
What must be verified before and after rollback?
change.needed: Change identifiers, deployment times, test results and an approved rollback are needed to link a regression to a change.
change.decision: Verify the change record, scope, rollback and acceptance criteria with the change owner.

modernization.purpose: Assess the dependencies and evidence gaps behind a site or service rollout.
questions: Which site dependencies could interrupt a rollout?
modernization.needed: Capacity, rollout tests, support coverage and recovery objectives are needed to establish deployment readiness.
modernization.decision: Resolve site evidence gaps and verify the fallback route before advancing the rollout.

autonomy.purpose: Use operational evidence to explain the boundary of a proposed automated action.
questions: Is the evidence fresh enough to evaluate the proposed action?
Which approvals and recovery checks still need a person?
autonomy.needed: An allowlisted runbook, permissions, approval policy and recovery checks are needed for production automation.
autonomy.decision: Check evidence, permission, scope and rollback; retain the simulated decision and verify recovery.

usecases.label: Checkout and Fulfillment Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Checkout and fulfillment share identity. Compare their symptoms with that dependency before engaging every store team.

usecases.label: Distribution Facility Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: A facility condition can delay order fulfillment. Review environmental evidence and the data-platform path alongside waiting orders.

usecases.label: Commerce Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Isolating a gateway can affect checkout and store operations. Review dependent functions and continuity before containment.

usecases.label: Order Platform Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Order data-platform regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: Order fulfillment depends on the data platform. Compare the change hypothesis, queue evidence and rollback readiness.

usecases.label: Store Connectivity Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: A store rollout requires shared access, partner exchange and working site connectivity. Separate site symptoms from shared dependencies.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Commerce Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: A standby-pool recovery can illustrate bounded automation while checkout and fulfillment evidence remains available for review.

usecases.label: Production and Quality Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Scheduling and quality release share identity. Narrow the investigation before assuming independent plant application failures.

usecases.label: Plant Data Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: Environmental conditions can affect the data supporting quality release. Examine that path without claiming to control industrial equipment.

usecases.label: Production Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Containment can interrupt scheduling and shipment exchange. Review business consequences and the approved continuity path.

usecases.label: Quality Platform Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Quality data-platform regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A data change can delay quality work. Compare observations, ownership and rollback before approving a recovery step.

usecases.label: Plant and Supplier Site Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: Modernization readiness includes local connectivity, shared systems and supplier-facing work. Identify the missing or degraded dependency.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Production Support Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: The simulated standby action applies to shared identity only. Fresh evidence and a clear boundary keep production-system changes outside the demonstration.

usecases.label: Warehouse and Dispatch Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Picking and dispatch can show related symptoms when shared identity degrades. Use ownership and current evidence to focus the investigation.

usecases.label: Dispatch Facility Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: A cooling event can affect dispatch data. Compare physical conditions with the shipment work waiting on that platform.

usecases.label: Shipment Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Gateway isolation can interrupt warehouse exchange and tracking. Review the dependency scope before choosing containment.

usecases.label: Dispatch Data Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Dispatch data regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: Dispatch depends on current data. Examine the observed regression, responsible team and rollback readiness before a decision.

usecases.label: Depot Connectivity Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: A new depot needs reliable access to shared services and tracking. Separate a local connection problem from a shared outage.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Logistics Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: The standby-pool simulation demonstrates a bounded recovery with warehouse and dispatch consequences visible in the same scope.

usecases.label: Banking and Payment Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Banking and payment processing share identity in this scenario. Review current evidence before clearing or escalating an application team.

usecases.label: Payment Data Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: Environmental evidence and payment-data availability belong in the same continuity review. Illustrative transaction counts do not establish financial loss.

usecases.label: Banking Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Containment can affect customer banking and fraud-review exchange. Inspect dependent functions and evidence gaps before deciding.

usecases.label: Payment Platform Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Payment data regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A payment-platform change requires impact, ownership and rollback review. The scenario does not certify regulatory compliance.

usecases.label: Branch Service Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: Branch readiness includes shared access, integration and network availability. Trace those dependencies before attributing a service interruption.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Banking Support Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: The simulated action affects a standby identity pool. It demonstrates an evidence gate without authorizing changes to payment systems.

usecases.label: Customer Access and API Impact
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Shared identity can produce customer and API symptoms. Inspect the common path before escalating several independent service teams.

usecases.label: Regional Data Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: Physical infrastructure still supports digital services. Follow the platform path and verify evidence before discussing regional continuity.

usecases.label: API Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Gateway containment can disrupt customer access and support exchange. Keep security and service reliability in the same impact review.

usecases.label: API Data Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: API data regression after a deployment
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A deployment hypothesis needs chronology, dependency context and rollback evidence. A temporal relationship alone does not prove cause.

usecases.label: Regional Service Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: Regional expansion requires connectivity, identity and integration readiness. Distinguish shared failures from incomplete observations.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Service Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: A standby-pool action illustrates a repeatable, evidence-gated recovery without making an external infrastructure change.

usecases.label: Tenant and Building Service Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Tenant requests and building operations share digital access. Investigate that path alongside site evidence and responsible owners.

usecases.label: Building Service Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: Environmental conditions can interrupt the digital systems supporting an occupied property. The app does not operate building controls.

usecases.label: Property Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Containment may disrupt tenant and workplace workflows. Review digital dependencies and physical-access evidence without assuming missing signals are healthy.

usecases.label: Building Platform Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Building-service data regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A property-system change requires a reviewed dependency scope, rollback and continuity plan for affected building operations.

usecases.label: Property Connectivity Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: New property readiness spans connectivity, support ownership and occupied-site continuity. Compare local and shared observations.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Workplace Support Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: Automatic simulation is limited to a standby identity pool. Building control and physical-access changes remain outside its scope.

usecases.label: Reservation and Check-in Access
usecases.action: Fail over the identity endpoint
usecases.why: Reservations and property check-in share identity. Use current observations to narrow the investigation before escalating every property.

usecases.label: Property Check-in Continuity
usecases.action: Transfer workload to the alternate facility
usecases.why: A site condition can affect the data supporting check-in. Review environmental evidence and guest-service continuity together.

usecases.label: Guest Service Gateway Containment
usecases.action: Simulate isolating the affected gateway
usecases.why: Gateway isolation may affect reservations and guest-service exchange. Review dependent functions and continuity before containment.

usecases.label: Check-in Platform Change Readiness
usecases.symptom: Check-in data regression after a change
usecases.action: Roll back the staged database change
usecases.why: A platform change can create waiting check-in work. Compare its timing, ownership and rollback plan against actual observations.

usecases.label: Property Opening Readiness
usecases.action: Activate the validated continuity route
usecases.why: Opening readiness includes working shared services, local connectivity and support ownership. Trace the path before attributing the interruption.
usecases.rollback: Return to the primary network route

usecases.label: Bounded Guest Support Recovery
usecases.action: Simulate restarting the standby connection pool
usecases.why: An allowlisted standby-pool simulation demonstrates bounded recovery while reservation and check-in consequences remain visible.
